what.title: What is Alzheimer's disease? Dementia vs Alzheimer's
what.description: Dementia is a pattern of decline that several diseases can cause, and Alzheimer's is the most common. Who it affects and how the odds change with age, animated.

brain.title: How Alzheimer's spreads in the brain: Braak and Thal stages
brain.description: Tau tangles and amyloid plaques spread through the brain in a fixed order, but not the same order. Step through the Braak tangle stages, then compare amyloid.

amyloid.title: Amyloid beta and plaques in Alzheimer's, animated
amyloid.description: How amyloid beta is cut from APP, why the enzyme that cuts first decides whether it is made, how it builds into a plaque, and the debate about the amyloid idea.

tau.title: Tau and neurofibrillary tangles in Alzheimer's
tau.description: Tau holds the tracks inside a nerve fibre together. In Alzheimer's it collects too much phosphate, lets go and folds into tangles that spread. Animated.

glia.title: Microglia, inflammation and synapse loss in Alzheimer's
glia.description: Synapses are lost early in Alzheimer's, and the brain's own immune cells help remove them. Microglia, inflammation, pruning and the link to memory loss.

genes.title: Alzheimer's genes: APOE4, PSEN1, APP and Down syndrome
genes.description: Most Alzheimer's is not inherited in a simple way. APOE shifts the odds; rare genes such as PSEN1 and APP all but guarantee it, as does an extra chromosome 21.

cascade.title: The Alzheimer's biomarker cascade: 20 years before symptoms
cascade.description: Alzheimer's changes the brain long before anyone notices. Biomarkers turn abnormal in order: amyloid, then tau and nerve-cell damage, then thinking.

stages.title: Stages and symptoms of Alzheimer's, from MCI to severe
stages.description: Alzheimer's takes away abilities in a fairly fixed order, from the hardest tasks to the most basic. Which everyday abilities are kept and lost at each stage.

dx.title: Alzheimer's diagnosis: blood tests, PET, spinal fluid, MoCA
dx.description: How Alzheimer's is diagnosed, layer by layer: the criteria, amyloid and tau PET, spinal fluid, p-tau217 blood tests and screening tools such as the MoCA.

ddx.title: Alzheimer's or something else? The differential diagnosis
ddx.description: Not every memory problem is Alzheimer's. Delirium, vascular, Lewy body, frontotemporal and reversible causes, told apart by how they start and what comes first.

synapse.title: Cholinesterase inhibitors and memantine for Alzheimer's
synapse.description: How donepezil, rivastigmine, galantamine and memantine act at the synapse, animated, and what the trials say the benefit of each really is.

antibody.title: Lecanemab and donanemab: anti-amyloid antibodies over time
antibody.description: Lecanemab and donanemab clear amyloid plaque. Follow the trials month by month: plaque falls fast, ARIA shows up early, and the benefit is slow and modest.

bpsd.title: Agitation, mood, psychosis and sleep in dementia (BPSD)
bpsd.description: Agitation, low mood, apathy, suspicion and poor sleep are common in dementia. The DICE approach to finding the cause first, and the cautions on antipsychotics.

prevent.title: Lowering dementia risk: the 14 modifiable risk factors
prevent.description: The 2024 Lancet Commission linked 14 risk factors that could be changed to dementia worldwide. The evidence behind each one, the caveats, and what trials show.

living.title: Living with dementia: a guide for caregivers and families
living.description: For people living with dementia and those beside them: the years after a diagnosis, planning, driving, home safety, end of life, and what helps family carers.

nursing.title: Nursing care in dementia: assessment, medicines, communication
nursing.description: Nursing a person with dementia: assessment such as the 4AT and PAINAD, giving the medicines, communication and care approaches, documentation and safety.

cure.title: Toward a cure for Alzheimer's: the pipeline and the trials
cure.description: Researchers are trying to interrupt Alzheimer's at every step. The drug pipeline, prevention trials and the evidence for each route, failures shown plainly.

history.title: History of Alzheimer's disease, from Auguste Deter to today
history.description: From Auguste Deter in a Frankfurt asylum in 1901 to the anti-amyloid antibodies approved in 2023 and 2024: the milestones and the people, era by era.

review.title: Alzheimer's disease flashcards and mnemonics
review.description: Flashcards and mnemonics on Alzheimer's disease by topic: the disease, course and diagnosis, treatment, and living and caring. Flip, filter by part or shuffle.

quiz.title: Alzheimer's disease quiz, with explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on Alzheimer's disease: pathology, diagnosis, drugs, prevention and care. Every answer comes with an explanation. Take a mixed quiz or a part.

glossary.title: Alzheimer's disease glossary: every term explained
glossary.description: Plain definitions of the terms in Alzheimer's care and research, from APOE and ARIA to p-tau217 and TREM2. Searchable, each linked to the module it belongs to.

sources.title: Sources and references | Alzheimer's Companion
sources.description: Every reference behind Alzheimer's Companion: journal articles, guidelines, drug labels and trial registrations, searchable and filtered by topic.
